import sys

def dfs(ones, n, idx):
    quot = n // ones[idx]
    n %= ones[idx]
    ones_used_here = quot * idx
    if n == 0:
        return ones_used_here
    else:
        return ones_used_here + min(dfs(ones, n, idx - 1),
                                    idx + dfs(ones, ones[idx] - n, idx - 1))

def main():
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    ones = [0] * 17
    for i in range(1, 17):
        ones[i] = 10 * ones[i - 1] + 1
    ans = dfs(ones, n, 16)
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
